_comment: rosdep keys upstream rosdistro can't resolve on nixos. value is a list of nixpkgs attr paths ([] ignores the key), or {"linux": [...], "darwin": [...]}

_notes.gpiod: riptide_hardware2 exec_depend. jammy ships libgpiod 1.6. linux only, nothing on macos (gpio nodes would fail at runtime there)
_notes.riptide_SINB: deprecated, no such package. remove from riptide_bringup/package.xml (future work)
_notes.libqt5-charts-dev: upstream key has no nixos rule. declared by riptide_imu but unused there
_notes.nlohmann-json3-dev: not a real rosdep key (fails on ubuntu too), riptide_imu should use nlohmann-json-dev
_notes.CUDA: tensor_detector. find_package(CUDA) is optional and the package installs only python + launch files. no CUDA in the shells
_notes.ultralytics: tensor_detector's YOLO node. macos: ultralytics + cpu torch from nixpkgs (no cuda, the node falls back to the .pt). torch listed too: ultralytics only propagates torch.dev, which ros.buildEnv doesn't follow to torch's out. linux: not in the shells (nixpkgs torch has no cuda, the robot uses TensorRT), the node exits at start
_notes.collections: tensor_detector. python stdlib, not a rosdep key
_notes.OpenCV: tensor_detector. not a rosdep key (opencv is)
_notes.cv2: tensor_detector. not a rosdep key (python3-opencv is)
_notes.numpy: tensor_detector. not a rosdep key (python3-numpy is)
_notes.scipy: tensor_detector. not a rosdep key (python3-scipy is)
